notes: The text opens with a title («نسخة الدرج؛ مسائل محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري») and is a letter of questions answered by signature («التوقيع»); the Imam who answers is not named, so no chain is written.

«فروي لنا عن العالم عليه السلام» and «وروي عن العالم عليه السلام» are passive transmissions with no named transmitter; several sayings each carry their own unnamed transmission, so the report needs a ruling.
The letter's own words («أطال الله بقاءك») and the closing prayer are not chain.
